descent.title: Citizenship by descent
descent.description: Proving your lineage to a citizen parent or ancestor.

documents.label: Proof of name changes
documents.hint: deed poll or marriage records, if any

naturalisation.title: Naturalisation
naturalisation.description: The standard route via continuous lawful residence.

documents.label: Police clearance certificate(s)
documents.hint: from current and previous countries of residence

documents.label: Proof of income / self-sufficiency
documents.hint: employment contract, tax returns, bank statements

documents.label: Application form and fee payment receipt

marriage.title: Naturalisation via marriage
marriage.description: A reduced residency route for spouses of citizens.

documents.label: Your valid passport or travel document

birthright.title: Citizenship by birth (jus soli)
birthright.description: Acquired by being born in the territory.

documents.label: Child's birth certificate
documents.hint: issued in-country showing place of birth

documents.label: Application / registration form
documents.hint: for a certificate of citizenship if needed

cbi.title: Citizenship by investment
cbi.description: A direct route to citizenship through a qualifying investment.

documents.label: Proof of source of funds
documents.hint: bank statements, tax returns, sale proceeds

documents.label: Proof of investment
documents.hint: property contract, donation, or approved fund receipt

golden-visa.title: Residency by investment (golden visa)
golden-visa.description: A residence permit obtained through investment, often leading to naturalisation.

documents.label: Application form and residence fee payment

digital-nomad.title: Digital nomad / remote-work visa
digital-nomad.description: A flexible, lower-barrier residency route for remote workers.

documents.label: Proof of remote employment or business
documents.hint: contract, client agreements, or company registration

documents.label: Proof of the Japanese parent's nationality
Notification of birth / retention of nationality
documents.hint: filed within three months for children born abroad

documents.label: Guarantor letter(s)
documents.hint: a Japanese national who vouches for you

documents.label: Ancestor's naturalisation records
documents.hint: to confirm they remained Italian when relevant

documents.label: Irish-born parent's or grandparent's birth certificate
Parent's or grandparent's Irish passport / citizenship records
Portuguese parent's or grandparent's birth certificate
Proof of the ancestor's Portuguese nationality
Sephardic Jewish heritage certificate

Proof of qualifying investment
